def forward(self, L_x_ : torch.Tensor, L_u_ : torch.Tensor, L_v_ : torch.Tensor):
    l_x_ = L_x_
    l_u_ = L_u_
    l_v_ = L_v_
    chunk = l_x_.chunk(2, dim = -1);  l_x_ = None
    left = chunk[0]
    right = chunk[1];  chunk = None
    mul = left * l_u_
    mul_1 = right * l_v_
    sub = mul - mul_1;  mul = mul_1 = None
    mul_2 = left * l_v_;  left = l_v_ = None
    mul_3 = right * l_u_;  right = l_u_ = None
    add = mul_2 + mul_3;  mul_2 = mul_3 = None
    cat = torch.cat((sub, add), dim = -1);  sub = add = None
    return (cat,)
